notes: Use 'vandaag' to refer specifically to the current day. It combines 'van' (of) and 'dag' (day), meaning literally 'of this day'.

faults.quote: Use 'vandaag' to refer specifically to the current day.
faults.why: Restates the gloss; learners instead need the common expression 'vandaag de dag' (nowadays).
In standard Dutch, 'het druk hebben' is preferred over 'druk zijn' for having much to do.
